description: T-5265: references to a deleted sheet through a row insert above their cell. S!C4:C7 hold 1,2,4,8; sheet F holds, in row 1 (it stays) and in row 5 (it moves down), A =SUM(S!C4:C7), B =S!C4+1 and C =SUM(S!$C$4:$C$7). delete_sheet S makes each a reference to a missing sheet (table-delete-sheet: =SUM(#REF!C4:C7)); then insert_row 3 on F. Does a moved cell keep its text, shift its relative rows, or become a bare #REF!? Sheet Obs (never edited) holds, for F!A1, B1, C1, A5, B5 and C5 in turn, the value and the FORMULATEXT (A1:A12; the references to row 5 follow the moved cells).
